# Bundled historical dependencies

`cma.py` is copied byte-for-byte from the public `nea2.zip` archive linked in
the top-level `README_NEA2PLUS.md`.  It reports version `1.1.06` (23 January
2015), Nikolaus Hansen and Petr Baudis, BSD 3-Clause license.  The complete
copyright and license text is retained inside `cma.py`.

SHA-256 of this file:

```text
45d5299d9059a66bda0fca1eaf7f2905407372ad216ccc011f825d46a89b1052
```

This directory also contains the public `diversipy` 0.5 and `evoalgos` 0.6
Python modules used by `nea2.py`, and the exact `Individual` and
`ResourcesExhausted` definitions (with their containing `base.py`) from
`optproblems` 0.9.  The corresponding BSD license files are retained as
`LICENSE-diversipy.txt`, `LICENSE-evoalgos.txt`, and
`LICENSE-optproblems.txt`.
